lesson_title: The Three Guards in Your Distribution Board
hook_text: A current smaller than a tenth of an ampere can stop your heart. Here is the device that saves you.
clip_script: Open the distribution board in your home and you will find three kinds of guard. Too much current is the enemy. Too many heaters on one circuit, an overload, or a live wire touching a neutral wire, a short circuit, can heat cables until they melt and start a fire. Guard one: the fuse, a thin wire that melts on purpose and breaks the circuit. Never replace it with a thicker fuse or foil. Guard two: the circuit breaker, an automatic switch that clicks off and can simply be reset. But here is the shock: about 50 thousandths of an ampere through your chest can stop your heart, and a 16 ampere breaker would not even notice. So guard three is the earth leakage unit. It checks that the current going out equals the current coming back. If 30 thousandths of an ampere goes missing, maybe through you, it switches everything off in a blink.
visual_style: A distribution board opening; a cable glowing red; a fuse wire melting in slow motion; a breaker clicking; animated current going out and coming back with a mismatch alarm.
pacing: Mysterious open, three guards in quick succession, a dramatic pause on the heart fact, a fast finish.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and press the test button on your earth leakage unit with an adult.
